messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-9821 - high tail latency (p95/p99) for hosted generation endpoint in us-west-2. Rule: latency.p99 > 1200ms for 5m :rotating_light:
pd-bot: https://pagerduty.com/incident/PD-INC-9821 - page status: triggered (unacknowledged)
oncall-aaron: I’m on it, looking at dashboards now. grabbing logs and p95/p99 heatmap.
sre-liz: acked on PD and joining. any customer-facing impact yet?
oncall-aaron: Not seeing errors spike, just high tail latency. p95 ~ 450ms -> 950ms, p99 trending 1.3s -> 1.6s. Traffic steady.
eng-charlie: I can see increased KV cache evictions and backend queue depth rising on the sidecars. Likely hot keys in requests.
sre-liz: +1 on KV eviction. Top keys show a small subset of users causing long seq lengths. Looks like batching starvation too.
oncall-aaron: Runbook note: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency_tail - trying adaptive-batch-size toggle first.
eng-charlie: toggled adaptive batching to conservative on the affected pool (pool-id: gpupool-usw-1). Will monitor.
incident-bot: Action logged: adaptive_batching set -> conservative by eng-charlie at 7432105722
sre-liz: After toggle p95 dropped to ~600ms but p99 still ~1.2s. KV cache eviction rate decreased by 30%.
oncall-aaron: PD shows service-level error is not increasing, but SLO burn for the last 10m is 92% for p99 window. PagerDuty escalation policy will trigger next.
pm-eva: Heads up - we have a customer in us-west experiencing degraded chat experiences, CS already has one inbound ticket (CS-4512). Low priority but could escalate.
sre-liz: OK escalate mitigation. Plan: 1) route heavy requests to dedicated-fallback model variant (quantized), 2) spin up extra dedicated workers to absorb hot keys, 3) patch routing rule to shard hot keys to cold path.
oncall-aaron: Kicking off step 2: autoscaler override +20 replicas on dedicated-fallback (cmd: infractl scale --pool gpupool-dedicated-usw --replicas +20).
eng-charlie: Also enabling prefix-KV sticky routing for known hot keys (config: kvcache.sticky=true for prefix set). Applying now.
incident-bot: infractl action executed by oncall-aaron at 7432105735: scale triggered for gpupool-dedicated-usw -> +20
sre-liz: After +20 replicas p99 fell to ~850ms and p95 ~420ms. Customer ticket updated. CS says partial improvement.
pm-eva: I updated CS-4512: "We see latency improving after backend changes; CS will keep customer updated."
oncall-aaron: PagerDuty is still queuing escalation (we're at 2nd level now) - can someone monitor PD ack chain?
sre-liz: I'm monitoring PD. If we hit 3rd escalation in 5m I'll open a bridge and call SRE rotation.
eng-charlie: Observed tail spikes correlated with ~5% of requests with very long generation length (>2048 tokens). Suggest adding a protective circuit to reject/queue those upfront.
sre-liz: Temporary safeguard: added token-length guard to frontend (max_allowed_tokens=2048 -> 1024 for hosted-api path). This will reject or route long requests to batch-worker queue.
incident-bot: config change logged by eng-charlie at 7432105749: frontend token guard applied -> 1024
oncall-aaron: After guard p99 now ~700ms. SLO burn trending down 92% -> 35% for last 5m. PD escalation suppressed (no further level).
pm-eva: Noting customer impact: 1 affected customer with degraded UX; CS informed; product to follow up with mitigation plan.
sre-liz: Good. Next steps: 1) prepare post-incident card with root cause (hot keys + long seq requests), 2) add long-seq prefiltering in client SDK, 3) schedule capacity bump for gpupool-usw during peak.
oncall-aaron: I'm leaving a note for Hand-off: I have to step out in 20m. @sre-liz can you take rotation until 11pm PT?
sre-liz: ack. I'll run the vulcan checks and keep PD monitor on. If anything flares I'll wake up the on-call rotation.
eng-charlie: Will open a small PR to add circuit for long sequences and a metric for "requests_rejected_by_token_guard".
pm-eva: I'll create a customer impact postmortem stub and tag affected customer.
incident-bot: PD incident PD-INC-9821 status: acknowledged -> assigned to oncall-aaron and sre-liz; severity: high; notes appended.
oncall-aaron: handoff done, leaving detailed checklist: 1) watch p99 < 900ms for 15m; 2) confirm autoscaler backfill completes; 3) bubble any new PD events here.
sre-liz: Taking over. will post updates every 10m. :white_check_mark:
eng-charlie: quick logs snippet showing KV eviction rate drop after config:
```
[7432105730] kv_evictions/sec: 120 -> 85
[7432105740] p99_ms: 1600 -> 720
[7432105750] adaptive_batching: conservative enabled
```
noncall-aaron: thanks all. tagging this thread PD-INC-9821 for follow-up.
pm-eva: assigning postmortem owners: pm-eva, eng-charlie, sre-liz.
sre-liz: Closing notes for now — will reopen if PD escalates. Otherwise we’ll convert to incident follow-up ticket in 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
